        changes: { from: 0, to: current.length, insert: value }
      });
    }
  }, [value]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const view = viewRef.current;
    if (!view) return;

      effects: readOnlyCompartment.reconfigure(
        EditorState.readOnly.of(readOnly)
      )
    });
